description: Lukas Iffländer publishes a machine-readable corpus of publicly reported cyber incidents affecting railway systems worldwide. Zenodo archives release 0.4.1 from April 2026 under CC BY 4.0. The linked repository documents one YAML file per incident, controlled vocabularies and a JSON Schema, with generated CSV, JSONL and Frictionless exports. Its README states separate MIT terms for code and identifies an earlier German railway-security study as an input source. The corpus can supply incident classes and scenarios for cyber-disruption simulations. Public reporting is incomplete, and imported entries may carry a needs-review flag; incident count, temporal coverage and verification status remain unknown without checking the corpus. The README’s pending-release text is older than the archived release number. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. No incident files or software archives were downloaded.
